statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON / green. CME Globex is in scheduled daily maintenance, so continuous NQ price-path evidence is temporarily unavailable; Monday's record Nasdaq close remains context rather than current one-way evidence.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Current Tail is low during the maintenance interruption; the next evidence checkpoint is the 22:00 UTC Globex reopen, followed by Tuesday's cash-open and Federal Reserve speaker sequence.
headline: CME maintenance resets immediate Tail after a record Nasdaq close
body: Reuters reported a record Nasdaq close with the semiconductor index up 4.3%, lower oil and a 10-year Treasury yield below 5%. CME confirms the 17:00-18:00 ET daily maintenance period, so there is no continuous live NQ path to score in the current hour. Stress remains extreme because the strong prior trend can reappear at the reopen and Tuesday contains several policy checkpoints.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 clock-hour slots, Tail was low overnight, rose through WATCH and elevated before the U.S. open, reached high during the cash-session continuation and power hour, and remained elevated into the post-close hour.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is 18% / low during CME maintenance. The 22:00 UTC Globex reopen is a WATCH checkpoint. Overnight risk is low absent renewed one-way structure; Tuesday's principal conditional danger window is 13:30-15:30 UTC around the cash open and Williams/Jefferson remarks, with Barkin and power hour as later checkpoints.

forecast.analysis: Observed: CME Globex is in its scheduled daily maintenance period, so continuous NQ price-path evidence is unavailable in this hour. Monday's record Nasdaq close and strong semiconductor leadership remain context, but they are not current continuation evidence.

forecast.analysis: Conditional: at the Globex reopen, WATCH applies if NQ immediately holds near prior extremes and extends with shallow or failed pullbacks. A balanced reopen with ordinary retracement would keep Tail low.

forecast.analysis: Conditional: late-evening Tail stays low if reopened futures rotate two-way after the prior strong close. Repeated failed retracements and renewed extension would move risk back toward WATCH.

Conditional: the overnight reset remains low Tail while futures show ordinary retracements and no persistent break from the reopened range. A clean directional break that resists retracement would raise risk.
Conditional: early Asia remains low Tail absent sustained extension. Thin liquidity raises uncertainty more than Tail unless price repeatedly rejects meaningful retracement.
Conditional: Asia stays low Tail if pullbacks continue to interrupt direction. Repeated shallow pullbacks followed by fresh extremes would be the main escalation signal.
Conditional: the Asia session remains low Tail while directional efficiency stays ordinary. A sequence of failed retracements would matter more than headline volatility alone.
Conditional: the Asia-Europe handoff remains low Tail unless NQ breaks a prior extreme and sustains the move without meaningful retracement.
Conditional: early Europe remains low Tail if price discovery stays two-way. Fresh cross-asset alignment would matter only if NQ simultaneously develops persistent direction.
Conditional: Europe remains below WATCH absent repeated extension. A one-way move accompanied by shallow pullbacks would be the evidence needed for escalation.
Conditional: approaching the U.S. morning, Tail remains low if European trading has allowed normal retracement. Extreme-holding plus fresh extension would invalidate the low-Tail base case.
Conditional: WATCH begins if the prior technology-led direction persists into the U.S. premarket with limited retracement; otherwise the overnight structure remains ordinary.
Conditional: U.S. premarket Tail reaches WATCH if NQ remains near an overnight extreme and pullbacks stay shallow. A deeper rotation would lower directional-path risk.
Conditional: WATCH persists only if premarket direction remains efficient. Two-way rotation before New York would weaken the continuation branch despite Monday's strong close.
Conditional: late premarket Tail stays at WATCH if NQ holds near extremes into the U.S. session. Meaningful retracement before the opening auction would reduce the one-way-path concern.
Conditional: the final full hour before the cash open carries higher Stress. Tail stays at WATCH unless the premarket already shows persistent one-way structure and failed retracements.

Conditional: the 13:30 UTC cash open can lift Tail into the elevated band only if the opening auction extends direction and early pullbacks remain shallow or fail. A substantive two-way opening rotation would invalidate that branch.

Conditional: Williams at 14:05 UTC and Jefferson at 14:20 UTC raise Stress. Tail reaches 30% only if their remarks coincide with an already persistent directional NQ path, failed retracements or renewed extension after the cash open.
Conditional: after the speaker sequence, Tail eases if price discovery broadens into two-way rotation. Continued failed pullbacks and session-extreme holding would keep the elevated state intact.
Conditional: midday Tail falls to WATCH if the morning move has retraced meaningfully. Persistent one-way extension through midday would keep risk elevated instead.

Conditional: Barkin's scheduled 17:00 UTC remarks are a policy checkpoint. Tail reaches the elevated threshold only if the market enters the event with persistent direction and resists meaningful retracement.
Conditional: late afternoon returns to WATCH if the policy sequence has not produced a persistent second leg. Fresh extension after failed retracements would reverse that de-escalation.

Conditional: power hour lifts Tail into the elevated band only if NQ is holding near session extremes and continues to extend after shallow or failed pullbacks. A broad closing rotation would lower the path risk.
Conditional: into the cash close, Tail remains just elevated if one-way power-hour structure persists. A closing rotation or deeper retracement would move the path back toward WATCH after the bell.

forecastDetail.comment: CME maintenance removes live NQ path evidence; prior record-close context remains, but immediate Tail is low.

Late-evening Tail stays low with two-way rotation; repeated failed retracements would be the escalation trigger.
The overnight reset stays low Tail while normal retracements persist; a sustained directional break would raise risk.
Early Asia is low Tail absent sustained extension; thin liquidity alone raises uncertainty more than Tail.
Asia stays low Tail if pullbacks interrupt direction; repeated shallow pullbacks followed by fresh extremes would raise risk.
